description:
A company's financial statements from its last several 10-Ks or 10-Qs, in one call.

For trends (revenue, margins, cash flow) instead of calling get_financial_statements filing
by filing. Returns each filing, newest first, with its statements as filed. They are not
combined: periods repeat across filings (the newest filing's figure is current; it may
restate), and labels and scale can differ. Read the figures from each filing yourself.

Coverage: filings with XBRL, from mid-2009 to mid-2011 by company size. For earlier
reports read a 10-K's Item 8 with get_filing_item.

Args:
    cik: Company CIK (use search_companies to find it)
    period: "annual" (10-K, or a foreign filer's 20-F / 40-F; default 5 filings, max 10) or
        "quarterly" (10-Q, default 8, max 20; foreign filers report quarters on 6-K, not covered)
    statements: Optional subset: "income_statement", "balance_sheet", "cash_flow",
        "equity", "comprehensive_income". Ask for fewer to get more filings in one answer.
    limit: Number of filings to read
    before: Only filings filed on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD), for history as of a past date
    fiscal_year: Only filings for this fiscal year, as the company states it on the filing
        (fiscal, not calendar: Medtronic's fiscal 2018 runs May 2017 to April 2018)
    fiscal_period: "Q1", "Q2", "Q3" (a 10-Q) or "FY" (the annual report). There is no Q4
        filing: the fourth quarter is in the annual report. fiscal_year=2018 with
        period="quarterly" returns its Q1-Q3.
    include_tags: true to also get each statement as `lines`: every line's XBRL tag
        (concept, members, unit) and its figures for the filing's own period, each with
        value, printed text, a `ref` for check_citations and a `highlight_url`. For
        spreadsheet models: concept + members + unit is the same line in the next filing.
        No ref before mid-2019 (no inline XBRL); tags arrive the night after filing
        (`tags_note`). Larger responses: ask for fewer statements or filings.
name: get_financial_history
title: Get Financial History
